guidance.claim: Maintain medium to long term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for Wires & Cables.
guidance.quote: Consistent with our Project Spring roadmap, we continue to maintain our medium- to long-term margin guidance of 11% to 13% for this business.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030 in FMEG.
guidance.quote: EBIT margins for the quarter were 8%, very much in line with the milestones laid out under Project Spring, where we target EBITDA margins of 8% to 10% by FY 2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Grow at 1.5x to 2x of industry growth while enhancing profitability.
guidance.quote: Our strategic priorities remain unchanged to grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth while progressively enhancing profitability.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Expect working capital cycle to settle within 45 to 50 days.
guidance.quote: As these effects normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to settle within our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Expect sustainable operating margins for EPC business in high single digits.
guidance.quote: Over the medium to long term, we continue to expect sustainable operating margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single-digit range.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Expect to do 1.5x of market growth over the next 2-3 quarters.
guidance.quote: Over maybe 2-3 next quarters, you will see a trend, and you should definitely see 1.5x of market growth.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Expect INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores to come from Bharat Net alone.
guidance.quote: So we can safely say maybe 1/3rd of that should translate into revenue, maybe INR 800 crores to INR 1,000 crores may come from Bharat Net alone.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

guidance.claim: Export growth target of going north of 10% of overall top line by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have given our guidance of going north of 10% of our overall top line by 2030.
guidance.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.quote: Consolidated revenues grew by 39% year-on-year, supported by sustained momentum across both our wires and cables and FMEG businesses.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: EBITDA increased by 32% year-on-year with margins at 13.8%.
reported.quote: EBITDA increased by 32% year- on-year and the margins stood at 13.8%, reflecting an improvement of approximately 70 basis points sequentially over the previous quarter.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: Achieved highest ever quarterly PAT of INR 7,967 million, up 33% year-on-year.
reported.quote: At the bottom line, we achieved our highest ever quarterly Profit After Tax of INR 7,967 million, representing a growth of 33% year-on-year.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: Wires & Cables segment registered 39% year-on-year growth.
reported.quote: The Wires & Cables segment registered a healthy 39% year-on-year growth during the quarter.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.quote: The FMEG segment delivered another outstanding quarter, recording 71% year-on-year growth with strong contributions across all product categories.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick

reported.claim: EPC business reported revenues of INR 3,077 million, down 11% year-on-year.
reported.quote: The EPC business reported revenues of INR 3,077 million during the Quarter 1 Financial Year 2027, reflecting a year-on-year decline of 11%, primarily due to the timing and execution cycle of projects.
reported.speaker: Shashank Yagnick
